card.name: Place or era modifier before a noun
card.fires_on: Words like city, country, human, century, earthly or today that modify a following noun and mark a setting or era (city friends, country boy, 21st-century eyes). Seen in general web and literary text.

modes.label: City or country as modifier
modes.description: The word city or country used as an adjective before a person or activity noun.

modes.label: Era or world modifier
modes.description: A century, today or human/earthly word that qualifies a following noun.

card.writes: It favors suffixes like -style and words like logic or mentality, which suggest a noun phrase turning into a described type or style.
card.plain: It fires on a descriptive word like city, country or century that sits before a noun and names a setting or era.
